logp.method_description: To measure the lipophilicity of the 99mTc complexes, the partition coefficient was determined according to a method described previously. Briefly, 0.1 mL of the radiolabeled complex was added to a mixture of phosphate buffer solution (0.025 mol/L, pH = 7.4, 0.9 mL) and 1-octanol (1.0 mL) in each centrifuge tube, vortexed for 3 min, and centrifuged for 5 min to obtain two clear separated layers. Equal aliquots (100 μL) in triplicate were withdrawn from 1-octanol and phosphate buffer and measured in a γ-counter, and the value of P was determined as follows: P = (counts in 1-octanol layer)/(counts in phosphate buffer layer).
